<thought>To find the appropriate retrosynthetic template, I will search the template catalog for reactions that form C‑C bonds (typical of a Diels‑Alder cycloaddition) using the target molecule SMILES. This should return candidate templates, after which I can check which one matches the molecule and retrieve the mapped reaction SMILES.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "COC([C@]12CC=CC[C@H]1C(C2)=O)=O",
    "bonds_formed": ["C-C"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
